mapper.select: SELECT config_key,config_value,remark,updated_at FROM bike_system_config ORDER BY config_key
SELECT config_key,config_value,remark,updated_at FROM bike_system_config WHERE config_key=#{configKey}
SELECT config_value FROM bike_system_config WHERE config_key=#{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_system_config(config_key,config_value,remark,updated_by) VALUES(#{configKey},#{request.configValue},#{request.remark},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value=VALUES(config_value),remark=VALUES(remark),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by)

INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type,business_id,action,operator_id,operator_name,before_data,after_data,client_ip,remark) VALUES('SYSTEM_CONFIG',#{businessId},'更新系统配置',#{operatorId},#{operatorName},JSON_OBJECT('value',#{beforeValue}),JSON_OBJECT('value',#{afterValue}),#{clientIp},'系统配置更新')
